Street engine (vendor/street-engine.wasm)
=========================================

Built from Graphways (https://github.com/kyleloving/graphways), MIT licensed —
see graphways-LICENSE.txt — at commit bf2184f, compiled for
wasm32-unknown-unknown with default features off, plus the patch kept at
docs/spikes/129-graphways-wasm/graphways-bf2184f.patch. That patch adds three
things the published crate does not have, all needed because a browser has no
filesystem and a study area is not a country:

  * read_pbf_bytes / read_pbf_bytes_two_pass — read an extract already in
    memory, and read the ways first so only the nodes a road refers to are kept
  * a study-area bounding box applied while the extract is decoded, to nodes
    AND to ways
  * nothing else; the graph building, routing and isochrone code is unmodified

The module exports plain C functions and is instantiated directly. It carries
no JavaScript glue and no wasm-bindgen.

Rebuilding it is documented in docs/spikes/129-graphways-wasm/README.md and
needs a Rust toolchain, which this repository otherwise does not.

OpenStreetMap data read by this module is © OpenStreetMap contributors and
licensed under the Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0. Extracts published by
Geofabrik GmbH carry the same licence. Attribution travels with any network
acquired through it.
